title: Compute decreasing certified rational gap uppers without a stationary normalizer oracle
statement: For NONSINGLETON Gamma and rational finite-support f, compute A_f=sum w f^2,B_f=sum w f,D_f=.5sum_(x,r)w(x)q_r(x)(f(x+Delta_r)-f(x))^2, w=c^x/x!. Only support points and their finite reaction predecessors contribute. For finite K subsetGamma, Z_K=sum_K w<=Z. Whenever A_f-B_f^2/Z_K>0, U(f,K)=D_f/[A_f-B_f^2/Z_K] is rational and satisfies lambda<=D_f/[A_f-B_f^2/Z]<=U(f,K). A LOWER normalizer bound gives an UPPER gap bound. Enumerating rational f and finite K and taking successive minima after the first valid pair gives positive rational U_s decreasing to lambda by the accepted full form core. Consequently lambda=0 iff for every j there is s with U_s<1/j: a uniform Pi2 upper description (positive-gap Sigma2), not hardness or undecidability. Each zero instance has terminating searches for witnesses at each j, but no total classifier or uniform computable input,j witness-stage bound is constructed.
